title: SCH-CNT-002 mining-site class definition
description: A mining-site class definition. The project-owned typed validator in src/MechaMiner.Content/Categories/ remains authoritative; this schema is the draft 2020-12 mirror kept for editor and tool interoperability, and a fixture corpus proves the two reach the same accept/reject verdict on every structural case. See content/schemas/README.md. Every payout total is derived and none is authored: a seam's per-seam total is its installment payout times its installment count, and the rich seam's three 'twice the standard seam' multipliers are derived from another definition entirely.

beacon_threshold.description: A kind token plus an optional percentage replaces a string that held either 'Activation' or a percentage and duplicated a sibling on three rows of four.

trigger_progress_percent.description: The crossing this row fires at. Present on a progress threshold and forbidden on the activation row, which fires at the first progress of any amount.

minimum.derivation: a crossing strictly inside the extraction; zero is the activation trigger, which has its own kind, so the floor is the first whole point after it

maximum.derivation: a crossing strictly inside the extraction; one hundred is completion, which is not a crossing, so the ceiling is the last whole point before it
